Q1_why_h_gap_invalid.answer: h_gap measures geometric proximity, not semantic difficulty. 63% of geometric-adjacent pairs are trivial table cells. Tables have many closely-spaced cells, so the filter is overwhelmed by table structure.

Q2_which_types_to_keep.rationale: These have genuine MERGE/KEEP_SEPARATE ambiguity with plausible alternative interpretations

Q3_which_types_to_exclude.rationale: Two numbers in different columns or two column headers are trivially separable
Q3_which_types_to_exclude.important_note: Exclude trivial RELATIONS, not entire TABLE type. Ambiguous table structures (merged headers, irregular alignment) may still have HIGH value.

Q4_how_to_avoid_84pct_trivial.solution: Add structural classification + low-value filter AFTER geometric filter, BEFORE sampling
Q4_how_to_avoid_84pct_trivial.pipeline: geometric filter → structural classification → trivial exclusion → coverage selection

Q5_how_to_make_B1_vs_B2_measurable.pilot_validation: If B1 accuracy >90% or <3s rate >50%, cases still too easy

Q6_five_cue_test_types.Type1_Cue_Informative: B1 evidence exists but hard to access; B2 Cue reduces retrieval cost
Q6_five_cue_test_types.Type2_Cue_Redundant: Human can easily understand without Cue (control cases, minimal)
Q6_five_cue_test_types.Type3_Cue_Misleading: Cue looks helpful but cannot alone support correct judgment
Q6_five_cue_test_types.Type4_Evidence_Missing: Cue cannot compensate for missing evidence (UNKNOWN test)
Q6_five_cue_test_types.Type5_System_Not_GT: Cue direction ≠ GT direction (automation bias test)
Q6_five_cue_test_types.requirement: Each type needs ≥5 cases for statistical power

Q7_leakage_prevention.GT_leakage: GT assigned AFTER selection, not used FOR selection
Q7_leakage_prevention.Pilot_leakage: Pilot cases separated from formal evaluation set
Q7_leakage_prevention.Cue_leakage: Cue computed after case selection; selection based on structure not Cue content
Q7_leakage_prevention.data_separation: Discovery → Pilot → Frozen Evaluation → Independent Holdout

Q8_ceiling_floor_control.method: Exclude trivial cases, ensure evidence sufficiency, pilot validation

Q9_case_independence.current_problem: is11_efficientnet_p6: 95 candidates, is11_cs_001_p3: 87 candidates from single pages
Q9_case_independence.best_subset: PROSE+FIGURE: 41 candidates from 25 pages, 4 docs — most independent

evaluation_opportunity.definition: A Candidate has worth-measuring research space via Human Experiment
conditions: A. Human has meaningful semantic decision

challenge_vs_prevalence.rationale: Research question tests boundary support, not real-world prevalence
challenge_vs_prevalence.warning: Challenge Set results are NOT prevalence estimates. Cannot infer real-world error rates from challenge set.

merge_keep_imbalance.solution: Select MERGE-plausible candidates (prose same-sentence, figure caption), adjudicate GT, accept natural distribution but ensure boundary coverage

matched_cases.needed: Conceptually valuable for controlling case difficulty confound
matched_cases.example: Same structural pattern (sentence boundary) + different semantic context → isolate Cue effect from structure effect
matched_cases.implementation: Deferred to post-pilot refinement, not initial case set

pilot_redefinition.is_not: Pre-running the experiment to see results
pilot_redefinition.principle: Pilot → Case Quality Feedback, NOT Pilot → System Optimization

data_separation.pilot: Discover Human difficulty, iterable, NOT for final analysis
data_separation.risk_prevented: Discover failure → adjust system → same cases → false generalization

evidence_availability.principle: Evidence missing ≠ semantic difficulty. Must record and report separately.

human_feedback_role.type: Evaluation Design Feedback, NOT Runtime Rule

anti_overdesign.all_scripts: No new DICE runtime modules. All are standalone scripts and documentation.

candidate_pool_assessment.sufficient_for_balanced_set: YES (if ~45 needed, 68 > 45, but requires GT adjudication + Pilot)

final_decision.rationale: Design principles, pipeline, and protocol are fully defined. Candidate pool analysis shows sufficient evaluation-valuable candidates (~113) exist. However, actual case construction has NOT been performed — no new case set exists, no GT has been adjudicated for untapped candidates, no Pilot has been run to validate difficulty assumptions. The design is ready to guide future implementation, but implementation itself is not authorized.
final_decision.what_is_known: Design framework complete; candidate pool analyzed; sufficient candidates exist; P722 confirms ceiling effect
final_decision.what_is_hypothesized: ~30% of evaluation-valuable candidates are genuine boundary; non-trivial B1 accuracy 70-85%; sufficient MERGE cases available
final_decision.what_requires_pilot: Actual difficulty distribution; Cue effect on non-trivial cases; UNKNOWN rate; true independence after dedup
